Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.Required Expertise:
Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
Familiarity with CAS solutions (Sci Finder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, Web Ex) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).Qualifications:
Ph. D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline (preferred focus on drug discovery or pharmaceutical development).
Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training, customer success, or product consulting.
Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point).Location & Travel

The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.

title: Analista de controles internos
description:
Responsável por mapear, testar, monitorar e aprimorar os controles internos dos principais processos financeiros (P2 P, O2 C, R2 R, Tesouraria e Fiscal), garantindo conformidade com políticas corporativas, requisitos regulatórios e boas práticas de governança. Atua na identificação e mitigação de riscos, suporte às áreas de negócio e acompanhamento de planos de ação até a resolução.
Responsabilidades Principais
Mapear processos financeiros (P2 P/Procure-to-Pay, O2 C/Order-to-Cash, R2 R/Record-to-Report, Tesouraria e Fiscal).
Conduzir avaliação de riscos (operacionais, financeiros e regulatórios) e manter a Matriz de Riscos & Controles (RCSA) da área financeira.
Identificar pontos de falha, segregação de funções (So D) e oportunidades de melhoria.
Executar testes de desenho (Design Tests) e testes de efetividade operacional (OE Tests) dos controles financeiros.
Registrar evidências, documentar exceções e construir planos de ação com donos de processo, acompanhando prazos e efetividade.
Validar remediações e formalizar retestes.
Suportar rotinas de fechamento contábil (accruals, reconciliações, provisões, integrações de módulos do ERP).
Verificar controles chave de relatórios financeiros, reconciliações críticas e trilhas de auditoria.
Acompanhar aderência a políticas financeiras, manuais e controle de mudanças (Change Management) em sistemas (ex.: ERP).
Apoiar auditorias internas e externas (preparação de PBCs, evidências, walkthroughs).
Endereçar achados de auditoria e seguir planos de ação com as áreas responsáveis.
Contribuir para a atualização de políticas, normas e procedimentos de Finanças.
Propor otimizações e controles automatizados (ERP/BI/RPA) para reduzir riscos e aumentar eficiência.
Monitorar KPIs/KRIs de controles financeiros (ex.: aging de reconciliações, exceções de pagamentos, divergências de faturamento).Requisitos
Ensino superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
Inglês avançado
2–3 anos em Controles Internos, Auditoria Interna/Externa, Riscos ou Finanças.
Vivência em mapeamento de processos, testes de controles e acompanhamento de planos de ação.
COSO (obrigatório); SOX (desejável); noções de COBIT para controles de TI.
Processos financeiros: P2 P, O2 C, R2 R, Tesouraria, Fiscal/Tributos.
ERP (SAP/Oracle/TOTVS) e Excel/Power BI (intermediário/avançado).
Segregação de Funções (So D) e Controles de Acesso (desejável).
Competências Comportamentais
Pensamento analítico e orientação a detalhes.
Comunicação clara e habilidade de influenciar áreas (finanças e operações).
Organização, senso de urgência e foco em resultados.
Colaboração e postura consultiva.
Diferenciais
Certificações: CIA/CRMA/CCSA/CRISC.

title: Manager, site strategy & engagement
description:
Established in 1996 and rebranded toScoutin 2024, we built our foundation on planning meetings for numerous organizations within the life sciences sector (Scout Meetings). In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient travel and reimbursements, and Scout Academy, our secure, online, on-demand learning management system that ensures global compliance.Scoutis recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier. If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team!Position Summary:
The Manager of Site Strategy and Engagement is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clinical research sites, ensuring successful site engagement, and performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. This role involves collaborating with clinical operations teams, ensuring the utilization of the services scoped, and working to enhance site satisfaction and operational efficiency.Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:
Site Engagement:Identify, assess, and engage with potential clinical research sites in studies contracted to use Scout services, ensuring they are aware of the service and have everything needed to optimize use of the portal.
Site Support:Provide guidance and direction to sites and operations team members to drive strategy for continued use of the portal.
Site/Study Utilization Monitoring:Monitor site utilization throughout the trial, ensuring portal use and proactively addressing any issues or concerns that may arise at the site level.
Collaboration & Communication:Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Project Managers, Patient Lesions, Site staff, and sponsors, to ensure alignment on site-related needs.
Site Relationship Management:Cultivate long-term, productive relationships with clinical sites. Regularly check in with sites to assess their needs, gather feedback, and improve site engagement strategies.
Problem Solving & Issue Resolution:Anticipate, identify, and resolve any issues or obstacles at the site level to ensure continued use of the portal.
Regional Client Support:Support client conversations with regional specific expertise. Gather local market insights including challenges and recommend how Scout can best support or solve them.
Marketing for the region:Support marketing with drafting messaging with an emphasis on local, cultural, economic and regulatory considerations.
Complete all required initial and ongoing training within a reasonable or provided timeframe.The ideal candidate will have the following experience, skills, and knowledge:
Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related field, or equivalent experience
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in clinical research or clinical trial management, with a focus on site management or clinical site engagement.

title: Data engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!Who We Are:We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. “Get Shit Done.”

Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.Accountable for:
Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of Dev Ops and modern code development practices across the Data function.
Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.Essential skills and experience:
Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
Hands on Java experience
Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.Preferred skills and experience:
Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
Embrace change with a positive outlook.
Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.Join Our Global Team:We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. description: Sobre nós A Autoneum é líder mundial na gestão acústica e térmica de veículos. Os clientes incluem quase todos os fabricantes de automóveis na Europa, América do Norte e do Sul, Ásia e África. A Autoneum opera 67 instalações de produção e emprega cerca de 16 600 pessoas em todo o mundo. A empresa, com sede em Winterthur, Suíça, está cotada na SIX Swiss Exchange (símbolo AUTN). title: Sales engineer
description:
About the job
Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Sales Engineer based in Miami or Brazil. As a Sales Engineer at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.Key Responsibilities:Technical Discovery & Solution Design:Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.
Integration Lifecycle Management:Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.Customer Technical Support:
Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions. Debug customer accounts and resolve technical issues to ensure seamless operation.
Documentation & Developer Experience:Write and maintain API documentation and integration guides, including leading the development of our API V2 documentation. Ensure our technical content enables customers to self-serve effectively and reduces time-to-integration.
Internal Solutions Engineering:Build ops automation solutions for the sales side, particularly for customers who need to start moving money with us but cannot immediately integrate the API. Create workarounds and interim solutions that keep deals moving while maintaining operational integrity.
Product Feedback Loop:Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.Qualifications:
Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (required).
3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or developer relations.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
Experience within payments, crypto/web3, or fintech is a plus but not required.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).
